title: Returning the CondoGuard Deductible Credit Across the Billing Plan
content:
Condition of the CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy: the share of the full-year deductible credit returned for the rest of the term depends on how the term is billed.

**(a) Monthly EFT.** On a monthly EFT plan (12 installments a term) with at least one installment of the current term not yet billed, the deductible share is the whole calendar months from the day the raise takes effect to the expiration date plus one for the month in which the raise takes effect, never more than twelve, divided by twelve, where the installments billed are the premium installments posted with the current term's effective date.

**(b) Two-pay or quarterly.** On a two-pay or quarterly plan with at least one installment of the current term not yet billed, the deductible share is the number of the current term's installments not yet billed divided by the plan's number of installments (2 for two-pay, 4 for quarterly).

**(c) Any other case.** On any other plan, or when every installment of the current term has already been billed, the deductible share is the calendar days from the day the raise takes effect to the expiration date divided by the calendar days in the term.

| Plan | Installments of the current term not yet billed | Deductible share |
|---|---|---|
| monthly EFT | at least one | whole calendar months to the expiration date plus one, at most 12, divided by 12 |
| two-pay | at least one | unbilled installments divided by 2 |
| quarterly | at least one | unbilled installments divided by 4 |
| monthly EFT, two-pay or quarterly | none | calendar days to the expiration date divided by the calendar days in the term |
| annual or mortgagee escrow | any | calendar days to the expiration date divided by the calendar days in the term |

## Cases (hypothetical terms)

- Monthly EFT with installments unbilled, raise taking effect on 15 March, expiration date 1 November: whole months to the expiration date are 7 (to 15 October), plus one for March, 8; share 8 divided by 12.
- Monthly EFT with installments unbilled, raise taking effect exactly 12 whole months before the expiration date: 12 plus one is 13, held to twelve, share 12 divided by 12.
- Quarterly with installment 1 posted: 3 unbilled, share 3 divided by 4.
- A full-year deductible credit of 85.00 USD with share 3 divided by 4 returns 63.75 USD for the rest of the term.
